prompt: Implement the INI reader specified in README.md. The package `ini/` already exposes `loads`, `Config` and `IniError`, but `loads` (in `ini/parser.py`) and the methods of `Config` (in `ini/config.py`) are stubs that raise NotImplementedError. README.md is exact: follow every rule in it (line handling, comments, backslash continuation lines, section headers, key/value splitting, quoting, the case policy, the `duplicates` option, the exact spellings that `getint` and `getbool` accept, and which situations raise `IniError` with which `lineno`). The visible tests in `tests/` only cover the basics; your code will also be checked against the rest of the specification. Run the tests from the repository root with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
